title: Sovereign Plan IR v1.2
description: Normative executable plan contract compiled and validated by the Sovereign Controller. Plan IR v1.2 is the 2026-09-12.6 security/autonomy/resilience amendment. It preserves the v1.1 dependency/evidence/retry/rollback semantics and adds explicit untrusted-code isolation, stronger filesystem/process/network/package/browser/secret controls, audit policy, bounded replanning/model-call deadlines, and optional external-intelligence policy. Context levels remain ceilings/permissions rather than fill targets; semantic retrieval remains gap-driven and optional.
$comment: JSON Schema enforces structural validity. PlanValidator additionally enforces referential, graph, capability-intersection, revision-lineage, acceptance/verification-linkage, environment/tool-manifest, resource-conflict, and state-transition semantics described by the frozen architecture.

supersedes_revision.description: Must be null for revision 1. For revision N>1, semantic validation requires this to identify the previously active revision of the same plan_id; branching authoritative revision histories are not allowed.

networkPolicy.$comment: Semantic validation requires write-like methods/actions to also hold network_write or external_side_effect authority plus reconciliation. Host allowlisting is not sufficient until DNS resolution and the connected peer satisfy address policy; ambient proxy is denied.

externalIntelligencePolicy.$comment: Normal local profile uses allowed_providers=[] and raw_repository_export=deny. explicit_grant_only is only a global ceiling: a task must also allow the exact provider/data class and a separate persisted grant must bind the external escalation manifest. External output never gains tool authority.

taskExternalIntelligencePolicy.$comment: Task-level narrowing of global external-intelligence policy. whole_repository_export=explicit_grant_only does not itself grant export; the global ceiling must permit it and an exact persisted grant must bind provider/purpose/payload manifest.

index_snapshot_id.description: Nullable during the M1 exact-retrieval slice. Semantic validation requires a compatible non-null snapshot when a task requests lexical/symbol/dependency/semantic indexed evidence.

dependency_bindings.description: Machine-readable inputs consumed from hard dependencies. PlanValidator requires exactly one binding for every dependencies[] task ID and forbids bindings to non-dependencies.

permissions.description: Requested task capability ceiling only. Effective runtime authority is the intersection of Controller/global policy, project policy, this request, role/tool ceilings, and any persisted user approval/grant.

satisfaction.description: How the Controller proves this requirement satisfied. query_completed proves acquisition completed but does not by itself prove a truth/absence claim; evaluator_pass requires a governed evaluator over retained evidence.

freshness.description: Minimum provenance/freshness domain required for evidence satisfying this requirement.

evidence_freshness.description: Required freshness of evidence used to satisfy this criterion. Carry-forward is allowed only after the Controller revalidates the task/dependency/input fingerprints.

verification.$comment: PlanValidator requires globally unique step IDs within the task, bidirectional criterion<->step linkage, evidence-type compatibility, and that every command_spec.tool_id resolves to one of task.tools and to a compatible ToolManifest/toolchain capability for the repository snapshot.

max_attempts.description: Maximum started execution attempts for this task contract, including the initial attempt.

same_failure_limit.description: Maximum recorded occurrences of one normalized failure signature before another identical repair attempt is forbidden.

max_peak_rss_mb.description: Admission estimate/managed-process ceiling, not a claim about additive physical unified-memory use. Live host memory pressure may deny a lease even below this value.

max_output_bytes.description: Aggregate observed tool/process output ceiling for the task. This is distinct from retained post-ingress CAS/spool quota and from model-context token budgets.

max_retained_raw_bytes.description: Task quota for retained post-ingress/redacted raw bytes in spool/CAS. Exceedance requires explicit segmentation/truncation evidence with raw_complete=false; it is never silently dropped.

heavy_leases.description: Heavy capability classes this task may request across its lifetime; this does not authorize simultaneous residency. Hardware policy owns pairwise exclusion/conditional-admission rules. BROWSER covers deterministic/adaptive browser subtypes; INDEXER covers native, semantic-build, large multi-repo, and optional CodeGraph/wiki index/build subtypes, each with tool-specific calibrated lease estimates.

contextBudget.$comment: The Controller builds the smallest sufficient packet. Permitting C2/C3/C4 does not require filling them. In particular, C4 is permission for gap-driven semantic/docs evidence, never a default vector-RAG route. Per-route candidate/injection limits and packet partitioning are hardware/Controller policy and are recorded in runtime RetrievalTrace/ContextMetrics rather than duplicated into every task contract.
